integrity: Complete elementary proof and independently implemented finite exhaustive checker are supplied; no independently verified originality or externally certified proof is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The exact solution-size enumerator applies to the all-on initial state and ordinary binary closed-neighborhood toggling on complete multipartite graphs.
The binary nullity and invertibility conclusions apply to all initial configurations, but their full weight enumerators are not calculated here.
Exhaustive finite computations corroborate only bounded profiles; the general theorem is proved algebraically.
Unindexed equivalent work under odd parity domination terminology remains possible.
title: Odd-part parity classifies all all-on Lights Out solutions on complete multipartite graphs
